curation.lead:
8VC is a venture capital firm founded by Palantir co-founder Joe Lonsdale, legally structured as Eight Partners LLC and headquartered at 907 S Congress Ave, Austin, TX. SEC EDGAR Form D filings record more than 60 fund entities across six flagship fund vintages, with Fund VI LP raising $998M as of January 2025 and total committed capital exceeding $6 billion [Finding #4749]. All fund entities list Lonsdale as sole executive officer through the general partner. 8VC's public equity portfolio, as disclosed in quarterly 13F-HR filings under CIK 0001667766, consists of a single material position: Joby Aviation (JOBY), an electric air-taxi company with $163M in active DoD contracts covering USAF Agility Prime and USSOCOM logistics. 8VC held 9.6 million shares valued at $78M at year-end 2024, reduced to 4.8 million shares ($63M) by Q3 2025 [Finding #5380, Finding #5393].

8VC's private defense portfolio is significantly broader than its public filings disclose. Alex Moore, first employee of Palantir Technologies, runs 8VC Defense and holds board seats at Palantir, Saronic (autonomous naval vessels, $4B valuation), Epirus (directed-energy counter-drone systems, $550M+ raised), Chaos Industries ($4.5B valuation), Gallatin AI (military logistics), CX2, iCOMAT, and Terra [Finding #4750]. 8VC co-led Epirus's $250M Series D round, and its Build program — which dedicates 25–30% of capital to co-founding startups — co-founded Epirus with Lonsdale in 2018 [Finding #4593]. In October 2025, 8VC announced a partnership with Apollo Global Management to deploy several billion dollars across defense, manufacturing, and energy [Connection #2785]. 8VC is also an investor in Erebor Bank, the digital bank co-founded by Palmer Luckey and Lonsdale, which received its OCC national bank charter in four months and targets the defense, AI, and crypto sectors [Finding #4752].

Forbes reported in August 2024 that 8VC employs two sons of sanctioned Russian oligarchs. Jack Moshkovich — son of Vadim Moshkovich, founder of agricultural conglomerate Rusagro and sanctioned by the EU, UK, Switzerland, Canada, and Australia following Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine — joined 8VC as an analyst in 2018 after graduating from Stanford and working at McKinsey's Moscow office, and was promoted to Partner in January 2025; he obtained US permanent residency in summer 2024 [Finding #4746]. Denis Aven — son of Petr Aven, president of Alfa Group and sanctioned by the EU, UK, and, as of 2023, by OFAC — joined 8VC in 2022 after being declined by another private equity firm specifically because of sanctions-related concerns; Moshkovich introduced Aven to 8VC [Finding #4699]. Lonsdale confirmed the hires and stated the firm operates under a strict compliance framework; the US National Counterintelligence and Security Center has issued bulletins warning that foreign states use investment firms to access information about defense technology companies through employment, independent of any direct financial relationship with sanctioned individuals [Finding #4699].

sections.title: Key Relationships
sections.content:
Joe Lonsdale is 8VC's founder, managing partner, and sole executive officer on every SEC Form D filing. He co-founded Palantir Technologies with Peter Thiel in 2003 and later founded 8VC; Alex Moore, Palantir's first employee, now runs 8VC Defense [Finding #4750]. This lineage means 8VC's defense investment strategy is built on operational knowledge of Palantir's government contracting model.

8VC is an early investor in Anduril Industries, the defense-technology company founded by Palmer Luckey. The 8VC–Anduril–Founders Fund axis extends to Erebor Bank: Luckey and Lonsdale co-founded the bank; Founders Fund, 8VC, and Lux Capital are lead investors; the bank targets the defense-tech ecosystem for banking services [Finding #4752]. Lonsdale's FEC records show $314K in total donations concentrated on members of the Senate Armed Services Committee (Cotton, Sullivan, Mullin, Scott, Ernst) and the House Armed Services Committee (Crenshaw, and Democratic Ranking Member Adam Smith), giving Lonsdale documented contact with the full oversight committee membership for 8VC's largest portfolio sector [Finding #5401].

Jack Moshkovich (Partner, 8VC since 2018) is the son of EU-sanctioned oligarch Vadim Moshkovich. Denis Aven (investor at 8VC since 2022) is the son of OFAC-sanctioned Alfa Group president Petr Aven; Moshkovich introduced Aven to the firm. Neither son is reported to have worked on defense-related deals at 8VC, and no financial relationship between the sanctioned fathers and 8VC has been documented [Finding #4746]. The NCSC's public-facing counterintelligence guidance addresses the category of concern without resolving it [Finding #4699].

In October 2025, 8VC entered a strategic partnership with Apollo Global Management to jointly deploy capital in defense, manufacturing, and energy. SEC Chairman Paul Atkins's financial disclosure lists an 8VC Opportunities Access LLC stake valued at $25–50M, placing a sitting securities regulator as a fund investor in the same ecosystem [Finding #5205].

sections.title: Financial Activity
sections.content:
8VC's SEC-registered fund infrastructure comprises more than 60 entities, all Delaware limited partnerships or LLCs, all headquartered at 907 S Congress Ave, Austin TX. Fund VI LP ($998M offering, filed January 2025), Fund V LP ($880M), and multiple prior vintages are registered under CIK numbers 0002041827, 0002051048, 0002056351, and 0002076994. Defense-sector special purpose vehicles include Build Saronic SPV II LLC ($53.35M offering, $47M sold across 27 investors), ERSA SPV LLC ($42.15M fully sold, 30 investors, Epirus-related), and EPSD SPV LLC ($5M, Epirus). Six AI Fund vehicles and multiple Entrepreneurs Fund entities complete the structure [Finding #4749].

8VC GP I LLC (CIK 0001667766) holds Joby Aviation as its sole material public equity position. The position peaked at $101.2M (9.6M shares) in Q2 2025, was halved to 4.8M shares ($77.4M) in Q3 2025, and stood at $63.3M at year-end 2025. Joby holds $163M in DoD contracts under USAF Agility Prime and USSOCOM/CENTCOM logistics programs at MacDill AFB; it partnered with L3Harris on a hybrid VTOL program for military use in August 2025 [Finding #5380, Finding #5393]. A cross-fund pattern in SEC 13F data shows that among four major tech-right-adjacent funds (Founders Fund, 8VC, a16z, Coatue), none hold positions in traditional defense primes — Lockheed, Northrop, Raytheon, L3Harris, General Dynamics, or Boeing — nor in defense IT services firms. Their defense exposure is concentrated in private companies whose contracts are not captured in public filings [Finding #5408].

Lonsdale's personal FEC donations of $314K include a pattern of systematic giving to both Republican and Democratic members of Senate and House Armed Services Committees — the oversight bodies for the sector in which 8VC has the largest private portfolio [Finding #5401]. Neither Founders Fund nor 8VC's 13F filings disclose Palantir equity, despite Thiel's chairmanship and Lonsdale's co-founder role; those positions are held through personal accounts or limited-partnership interests not captured at the 13F threshold, meaning public-equity disclosures reflect only a fraction of their actual defense sector exposure [Finding #5402].

sections.title: Counterintelligence Context
sections.content:
8VC's defense portfolio companies hold classified government contracts. Anduril Industries has $1.43B in all-time DoD obligations and $862M with DHS; Palantir Technologies holds a $10B Army IDIQ and $2.31B in all-time DoD obligations. Saronic, Epirus, Chaos Industries, Gallatin AI, and Overland AI represent additional classified-contract exposure across 8VC's private portfolio [Finding #4750].

The US National Counterintelligence and Security Center has issued public bulletins warning that foreign intelligence services use employment at investment firms — not direct financial investment — to access information about defense technology companies and their classified programs. 8VC's Build program recruits personnel described on 8VC's own website as 'Navy SEALs, Nobel winners, and Palantir alumni' — individuals with operational knowledge of defense systems. The counterintelligence concern is structural: an analyst or partner with board-level access to a defense contractor, regardless of personal conduct, constitutes a potential access point [Finding #4699].

Jack Moshkovich's father Vadim Moshkovich founded Rusagro and, per InformNapalm reporting, also founded AssistAgro, a Ukrainian drone production company, placing the family at the intersection of agricultural conglomerate wealth and drone production. Denis Aven's father Petr Aven was co-founder and longtime president of Alfa Group, one of Russia's largest financial-industrial consortia, with documented contacts to senior FSB and Kremlin officials per the OFAC designation. Lonsdale stated no evidence exists of a financial relationship between either father and 8VC, and confirmed a strict compliance framework. No primary-source evidence contradicts this statement [Finding #4746, Finding #4699].

A synthesis finding (medium confidence, unverified) documents that Founders Fund, 8VC, and Palantir Technologies share three co-founders — Thiel, Lonsdale, and Rabois — who now operate investment, government-placement, and financial infrastructure functions including Erebor Bank. Five Trump administration appointees hold 8VC fund positions, according to ProPublica financial disclosures [Finding #5200, Finding #6510].

open_questions: Do the 8VC Build program co-founders — who are described as holding security-clearance-eligible backgrounds (Navy SEALs, Palantir alumni) — hold active clearances at the time of hiring, and does 8VC's clearance management process address family-of-sanctioned-person hiring?

What specific due diligence process did 8VC apply when hiring Jack Moshkovich and Denis Aven, and did it include NCSC counterintelligence guidance on access-risk from family relationships to sanctioned persons?

The halving of 8VC's Joby Aviation position (9.6M to 4.8M shares, Q2–Q3 2025) preceded the L3Harris VTOL partnership announcement in August 2025. What was the timing relative to any non-public contract news, and did 8VC or Lonsdale hold any advisory roles with Joby or DoD programs that would create material non-public information exposure?

The 8VC–Apollo Global Management partnership (October 2025) targets defense, manufacturing, and energy. What is the deal-origination structure: does 8VC contribute portfolio company relationships, or does it contribute LP capital? The answer determines whether this is a conflict of interest for 8VC's existing portfolio company relationships with Apollo.

Erebor Bank received OCC conditional approval in approximately four months — a timeline described by Comptroller Jonathan Gould himself as the first new national bank charter in four years. What was the formal application timeline, and which OCC staff were involved in the review? The bank's founders include a DOGE advisor (Lonsdale) and the application coincides with regulatory posture changes under the Trump administration.
